Qualifications & Requirements • Education: Bachelor's degree or above; . hospitality, hotel management, business degree. • Experience: A minimum of 4 to 9 years of combined hospitality experience and business management. Additional information: • Oversees 1 funeral home and 2 branch offices The General Manager’s Position is a Full-time position Monday- Friday (some Saturdays and Sundays if needed.) 8:30am - 6:00pm Valid state issued funeral director license a plus but not required; Be a part of a compassionate, mission driven team that values kindness, respect, empathy and exceptional service to the families we serve. Demonstrates business/management, customer service and good managerial skills with staff; willingness to learn all aspects of funeral services; Take advantage of ongoing training opportunities within the funeral service industry; Ability to lead and support the customer satisfaction; works cohesively with staff and builds strong relationships with all staff to give excellent customer service with empathy and kindness. jobgether-jobgether:lever:81be4fcf-9673-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will serve as a subject matter expert in patient-reported outcomes (PROs) and shape evidence strategies across the development lifecycle. The role partners closely with Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, and Clinical Operations. You will translate patient-centered evidence needs into practical study designs, endpoints, analyses, and scientific deliverables. Your expertise will contribute to regulatory interactions, market access strategies, publications, and benefit-risk assessments. Support the analysis, interpretation, and dissemination of PRO findings through clinical study reports, scientific publications, conference presentations, and other communications. Establish and improve processes, standards, and best practices for patient-focused drug development and clinical outcome assessments. Provide scientific guidance, coaching, and mentoring to colleagues while helping build organizational capabilities in PRO methodology. Requirements: Advanced degree such as Ph.D., Sc.D., Dr.P.H., Psy.D., M.D., Pharm.D., M.P.H., M.S., or equivalent in psychology, psychometrics, epidemiology, public health, health outcomes research, behavioral science, or a related discipline. pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:479e046e-45f6-4cc.title: Lead Account Strategy Partner (Forward-Deployed, Healthcare Data)
pearvc-pear-vc:ashbyhq:479e046e-45f6-4cc.description: ABOUT FLYWAY HEALTH At Flyway Health, we start from a simple conviction: somewhere in every life sciences team's data is a finding that would change their next quarter, and we've built the system to go find it. Our autonomous agents run across a variety of healthcare data, surfacing the signals commercial teams don't have time to look for – shifting prescriber dynamics, gross-to-net drift, unescalated lookalike patients, payer coverage changes, and more, all discovered autonomously. We've supported four launches in our first six months and are growing rapidly. We've raised roughly $4M to date and are backed by Pear VC, Greg Field, and a group of industry-veteran advisors — and we're here to change how commercial life sciences operates. THE ROLE As Lead Account Strategy Partner (ASP), you own client delivery as our most senior ASP — running your own portfolio of accounts and setting the standard the rest of the team works to. ASPs are the bridge between a client's commercial life sciences questions and the answers our system can produce. You do this work directly by wielding the system with skill, steering it, interfacing with our engineering team to integrate new datasets, and applying the judgment that turns raw healthcare data into insight a brand or market access team can act on. As the senior voice on a small, growing team, you set the bar for how delivery is done and help the ASPs around you do their best work — with the runway to grow into leading the function as we scale. This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll be in the weeds: setting up and working through claims and other healthcare datasets, learning about new therapeutic areas, running analyses through our system, and interrogating what comes back. You'll need real comfort with the fundamentals of data science paired with the client instinct to turn a result into something a commercial team can act on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own end-to-end delivery for your accounts: scope the client's question, run the analysis through our system, and deliver insights commercial life sciences stakeholders can act on. - Operate our proprietary agentic system day to day — directing it, integrating new datasets, and pressure-testing its output. The system is built; the skill is using it well and knowing which parts of the output are most pertinent to the client. - Work primarily with healthcare claims data, and quickly build intuition for the other datasets we use — picking up an unfamiliar dataset and understanding its shape and limits fast. - Read, follow, and reason critically about SQL and the results it returns. - Spot and account for the nuances of real-world healthcare data: sparsity, coverage gaps, claims lag, capture rates. Distinguish a genuine signal from a data artifact. - Translate fluidly between client commercial strategy and the technical realities of the data and the system. - As our most senior ASP, set the bar for how delivery is done and help the ASPs around you sharpen their craft — with the runway to grow into leading the function as the team scales. - Work directly with the founders and influence future product roadmap. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required - Commercial life sciences fluency from day one — you understand how pharma/biotech commercial teams operate (market access, brand strategy, commercial analytics, patient journey, HCP targeting, etc.). - LLM-native: genuinely comfortable working with AI and agentic tools — prompting, steering, and evaluating model output is second nature. - A data science or data engineering background (either in training / in practice) - A sharp, analytical mind that interrogates data and outputs rather than taking them at face value. - Comfort with healthcare claims data, or the demonstrated ability to ramp on a new dataset very quickly. - Comfort in a client-facing role, with strong people skills. - 2+ years of relevant industry experience. Nice to Have - Prior client-facing, consulting, or forward-deployed experience. - Familiari
